items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: I think that's about all I know about jazz. I never cared for it... Dr. Sushant, Edmond Sushant, had a band... They called it Sixth and Seventh and Eighth Band. And they played jazz. They played very well. Dr. Sushant was the leader of that, the organizer of that band.

ctx.x: Well, do you remember when they started being played at David John's parties or at Falls or anything like that? No.

Dr. Sushant, Edmond Sushant, had a band, the same other one, a little bit of chap. They called it Sixth and Seventh and Eighth Band. And they played jazz. They played very well. Dr. Sushant was the leader of that, the organizer of that band. And they kept it up several years. They used to play at different parties. And I think that's about all I know about jazz. I never cared for it, especially when I still don't.
Thank you very much, Mrs. O'Kelly. Thank you very much, Mrs. O'Kelly.
